entries.def:
κλύδων, -ωνος, ὁ
(κλύζω, of the sea, to wash over), [in LXX: Jon.1.4 Jon.1.12 (סַעַר), al. ;] 
a billow, surge: Luk.8.24, Jas.1.6.†
SYN.: κῦμα, a wave (AS)

κλυδωνίζομαι
(κλύδων), [in LXX: Isa.57.20 (גָּרַשׁ)* ;] 
to be tossed by waves; metaphorically, to be tossed like waves (cf. FlJ, Ant., ix, 11, 3): Eph.4.14.†
(AS)

Κλωπᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ (Aram.; on the original, see Lft., Gal., 267 f.), 
Clopas: Jhn.19.25.†
(AS)

κνήθω
(late form of κνάω), 
__1. to scratch. 
__2. to tickle; pass., to itch: 2Ti.4.3.†
(AS)

Κνίδος, -ου, ἡ 
Cnidus, a city (and peninsula) on S.W. coast of Asia Minor: Act.27.7.†
(AS)

κοδράντης, -ου, ὁ (Lat. quadrans, the fourth part of an as), 
a quadrans (AV, farthing): Mat.5.26, Mrk.12.42.†
(AS)

κοιλία, -ας, ἡ
(κοῖλος, hollow), [in LXX chiefly for בֶּטֶן, מֵעֶה, קֶרֶב, Deu.7.13, 2Sa.7.12, Gen.41.21, al.; also (Job.3.11; 10.18; 31.15; 38.8) for רֶחֶם ;] 
__1. the belly (stomach or intestines or both): Mat.12.40; 15.17, Mrk.7.19, Luk.15.16, Rom.16.18, 1Co.6.13, Php.3.19, Rev.10.9-10. 
__2. (As often in LXX) the womb: Luk.1.41-42, 44; 2.21; 11.27; 23.29, Jhn.3.4; ἐκ κ. μητρός (cf. Psa.22.11, Job.1.21, al.),…

κοιμάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַב ;] 
to lull to sleep, put to sleep. Mid and pass., to fall asleep (M, Pr., 162; M, Th., 1, 4, 13): Mat.28.13, Luk.22.45, Jhn.11.12, Act.12.6. Metaph, of death: Mat.27.52, Jhn.11.11 Act.7.60; 13.36, 1Co.7.39; 11.30; 15.6; 15.18; 15.20; 15.51, 1Th.4.13-15, 2Pe.3.4 (cf. Isa.14.8; 43.17, 2Ma.12.45).†
SYN.: καθεύδω (AS)

κοίμησις, -εως, ἡ 
[in LXX: Sir.46.19; 48.13 * ;] 
a reclining, resting: Jhn.11.13.†
(AS)

κοινός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX: Pro.1.14 (אֶחָד) Pro.21.9; 25.24 (חֶבֶר), Wis.7.3, al. ;] 
__1. common (general; = Lat. communis): Act.2.44; 4.32; κ. πίστις, Tit.1.4 σωτηρία, Jude.3 
__2. common (ordinary; = vulgaris); hence in LXX (1Ma.1.47, al.) and NT, unhallowed, unclean (cl., βέβηλος, which see): Mrk.7.2, 5, Act.10.14, 28; 11.8, Rom.14.14, Heb.10.29, Rev.21.27.†
(AS)
